data.current_description:
Streamable HTTP transport of the Model Context Protocol (protocol version 2025-06-18). Send one JSON-RPC 2.0 request, e.g. `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list` or `resources/read`, with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`. The response is a JSON-RPC response, either as `application/json` or as a single `message` event on a `text/event-stream`.

Without a valid token the server answers `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://threads-mcp.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"` (RFC 9728); follow it to start OAuth.
